summary: Frontend-only verification of P0: login-page theme toggle, in-app theme toggle, and polished OTP UI. All requested behaviours pass end-to-end on the preview URL.

issues: No obvious contrast/readability problems detected. Automated dark-text-on-dark-bg scan returned 0 hits across ~500 visible text nodes on the desk. Layout intact, task rows/tabs/inputs all readable in dark mode.

critical_code_review_comments: useTheme.js applies the theme inside useEffect after first paint — this can cause a brief flash of light content on hard reload when saved theme is 'dark'. Consider setting the html.dark class inline in index.html (script block reading localStorage before React mounts) to eliminate FOUC.
Login.js is 675 lines — beyond the >700 threshold it will soon cross. Consider splitting OtpBoxes and the multi-step Register wizard into their own modules for maintainability.
In Login.js the `useEffect` that starts the invite flow uses an empty dependency array with `inviteStarted.current` guard — fine, but ESLint may warn. Confirm no lint suppression is missing.
test_credentials: Demo owner via button data-testid='demo-login-owner' (owner@sharma.com / demo1234). Demo OTP phone: 9820010001 (real SMS is live; only pre-verify state tested, no code submission attempted).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Verified on https://founder-os-58.preview.emergentagent.com. Tests exercised: (1) /login floating theme toggle (data-testid=login-theme-toggle) toggles html.dark, writes localStorage 'decisionos-theme', persists across full reload. (2) OTP tab (login-tab-otp) initially shows single phone input (otp-phone-input) + 'Send OTP' button; after submit with 9820010001 the UI correctly swaps to (a) otp-phone-confirm showing 'Code sent to ••••• 0001' with a Change button (otp-change-number), (b) 6 boxes otp-box-0..5 inside otp-boxes container, (c) resend row (otp-resend-row) with a 30s countdown that ticked to 27s in 2.5s. Typing '1' in box 0 auto-advanced focus to box 1; typing 6 digits filled all boxes and enabled the 'Verify & sign in' submit button (which is disabled with <6 digits). Clicking Change returns to the phone-entry state (otp-phone-input visible, otp-boxes count = 0). (3) After demo-owner login the header theme-toggle (data-testid=theme-toggle) exists twice in DOM (desktop + mobile bar, one visible at a time on 1920px). Clicking it toggles html.dark; setting persists across a full reload of / (Decision Desk). No dark-text-on-dark-bg contrast issues detected by scanning the rendered DOM on the Decision Desk. OTP send request to APM took ~1–2s in this run — the earlier test that used a 4s wait was too short and observed the 'SENDING…' state.
rca of the issue: N/A — no defects reproduced. All P0 behaviours from the review request work as designed.
